title: Waking Up Your Spiritual Brain: Part 2

sentences.en: About a century ago, the Swiss psychiatrist Carl Jung was treating a young woman.
sentences.zh: 大约一个世纪前，瑞士精神病学家卡尔·荣格正在治疗一位年轻女性。

sentences.en: He sat with his back to a window, listening to his patient.
sentences.zh: 他背对着窗户坐着，倾听着病人的诉说。

sentences.en: She told him about a dream she'd had.
sentences.zh: 她向他讲述了自己做过的一个梦。

sentences.en: In it, she was given a piece of jewelry modeled after a beetle long considered sacred in Egyptian culture.
sentences.zh: 在梦中，她得到了一件珠宝，其造型模仿了一种在埃及文化中长期被视为神圣的甲虫。

sentences.en: The scarab beetle was associated in ancient Egypt with a divine force that moved the sun.
sentences.zh: 在古埃及，圣甲虫与推动太阳的神圣力量联系在一起。

sentences.en: Intricately carved scarab jewels were sometimes placed on the hearts of the dead to assist them in the afterlife.
sentences.zh: 有时，人们会将雕刻复杂的圣甲虫珠宝放在死者的心脏上，以在他们死后提供庇护。

sentences.en: The young woman told the psychiatrist that in the dream, she was given a golden scarab.
sentences.zh: 这位年轻女性告诉精神病学家，在梦中，她得到了一只金圣甲虫。

sentences.en: As Jung listened to the story, he heard a tapping behind him.
sentences.zh: 正当荣格听着这个故事时，他听到身后传来敲击声。

sentences.en: He turned to see a flying insect knocking against the windowpane.
sentences.zh: 他转身看到一只飞虫正在撞击窗玻璃。

sentences.en: In a monograph on what he called synchronicity, Carl Jung wrote,
sentences.zh: 在一篇关于他所谓的“共时性”的专著中，卡尔·荣格写道：

sentences.en: I opened the window and caught the creature in the air as it flew in.
sentences.zh: 我打开窗户，当那生物飞进来时，在空中把它抓住了。

sentences.en: It was the nearest analog to a golden scarab that one finds in our latitudes,
sentences.zh: 这是在我们所处的纬度能找到的与金圣甲虫最相似的东西，

sentences.en: a scarab-beard beetle, which contrary to its usual habits,
sentences.zh: 一只粪金龟，它一反常态，

sentences.en: had evidently felt an urge to get into a dark room at this particular moment.
sentences.zh: 显然在这个特定时刻感到了钻进暗室的冲动。

sentences.en: Scientists have debated Jung's theory for decades.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，科学家们一直在争论荣格的理论。

sentences.en: Many have argued that what happened in that room was nothing more than an interesting coincidence.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，那个房间里发生的事情不过是一个有趣的巧合。

sentences.en: But for Carl Jung, the beetle at the window was not merely evidence that in a complex world,
sentences.zh: 但对卡尔·荣格来说，窗台上的甲虫不仅仅证明了在一个复杂的世界里，

sentences.en: unusual things sometimes happen by chance.
sentences.zh: 不寻常的事情有时会偶然发生。

sentences.en: Synchronicity was a tap on the shoulder, a sign, an invitation into deeper realms of meaning and understanding.
sentences.zh: 共时性是肩膀上轻轻的一拍、一个征兆、一封通往更深层次意义与理解领域的邀请函。

sentences.en: Last week on the show, we discussed the research of Columbia University psychologist Lisa Miller.
sentences.zh: 上周的节目中，我们探讨了哥伦比亚大学心理学家丽莎·米勒的研究。

sentences.en: Over several decades of brain imaging and other research,
sentences.zh: 经过几十年的脑成像和其他研究，

sentences.en: she's found that when we encourage our mental capacity for spiritual and transcendent thinking,
sentences.zh: 她发现，当我们激发自己用于精神和超验思考的心理能力时，

sentences.en: it can have measurable effects on our brains and quantifiable benefits for our health.
sentences.zh: 它会对我们的大脑产生可测量的影响，并对我们的健康带来量化的益处。

sentences.en: If you missed our earlier episode, you can find it in this podcast feed.
sentences.zh: 如果你错过了我们之前的单集，你可以在这个播客动态中找到它。

sentences.en: It's titled, Waking Up Your Spiritual Brain, Part 1.
sentences.zh: 它的标题是《唤醒你的精神大脑，第一部分》。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, Lisa Miller takes us on a journey of synchronicity in her own life
sentences.zh: 本周的“隐藏的大脑”节目中，丽莎·米勒将带我们走进她自己人生中的共时性之旅，

sentences.en: and explains what it means to cultivate a mind that is open to the transcendent.
sentences.zh: 并解释了培养一个对超验保持开放的心灵意味着什么。

sentences.en: Columbia University psychologist Lisa Miller argues that we have two capacities in our minds.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚大学心理学家丽莎·米勒认为，我们的大脑有两种能力。

sentences.en: One is focused on goals and achievement.
sentences.zh: 一种专注于目标和成就。

sentences.en: She calls this the achieving brain.
The other is focused on meaning, connection, and transcendence.
sentences.zh: 另一种则专注于意义、联系和超验。

sentences.en: She calls this the awakened brain.
Lisa argues that when we cultivate our spiritual side, we activate three networks in the brain.
sentences.zh: 丽莎认为，当我们培养精神层面时，我们会激活大脑中的三个网络。

sentences.en: These networks give us the feeling that we are loved, that we are being guided, and that we are not alone.
sentences.zh: 这些网络让我们感受到我们被爱着、我们正受到指引、并且我们并不孤单。

sentences.en: The achieving brain might dismiss Carl Jung's synchronicities using the language of probability and coincidence.
sentences.zh: 成就大脑可能会用概率和巧合的语言来对卡尔·荣格的共时性不屑一顾。

sentences.en: But to the awakened brain, which is open to seeing connections,
sentences.zh: 但对于习惯于看到联系的觉醒大脑来说，

sentences.en: these events can open the door to exploration and growth.
sentences.zh: 这些事件可以为探索和成长打开大门。

sentences.en: Lisa told me of a time in her own life when she experienced powerful moments of synchronicity.
sentences.zh: 丽莎向我讲述了她人生中经历强大共时性时刻的一段经历。

sentences.en: She said that seeing these moments as signs, not just coincidences, changed her life.
sentences.zh: 她说，将这些时刻视为征兆而不仅仅是巧合，改变了她的人生。

sentences.en: Shankar, this was a journey of many, many years.
sentences.zh: 尚卡尔，这是一段持续了许多许多年的旅程。

sentences.en: It was perhaps one of the most excruciating journeys of my life,
sentences.zh: 这也许是我一生中最痛苦的旅程之一，

sentences.en: and certainly that of my husband as well.
sentences.zh: 当然也是我丈夫一生的痛苦旅程之一。

sentences.en: We were in our early 30s, and we decided we wanted to become parents, so we were going to so-called try.
sentences.zh: 我们三十岁出头，决定想要孩子，所以我们打算开始所谓的尝试。

sentences.en: We took a vacation to Sedona.
We took a vacation to the Caribbean and eagerly awaited the good news.
sentences.zh: 我们去加勒比海度假，急切地等待着好消息。

sentences.en: But, in fact, there was no baby, no pregnancy, no child.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，没有婴儿，没有怀孕，没有孩子。

sentences.en: And as these failed attempts, month after month, started to add up,
sentences.zh: 随着这些失败的尝试一个月又一个月地累积起来，

sentences.en: we got a very haunting sense that, wait a minute, maybe there's something wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们有了一种非常挥之不去的预感：等一下，也许有什么地方不对劲。

sentences.en: And as we moved into year one and a half and year two,
sentences.zh: 随着我们进入第一年半和第二年，

sentences.en: we saw a fertility doctor, and I checked out, and he checked out my husband as being healthy.
sentences.zh: 我们看了一位生育医生，他检查了我，也检查了我丈夫，确认我们都很健康。

sentences.en: They said, oh, we can get you pregnant, not to worry.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦，我们可以让你怀孕，不用担心。

sentences.en: And we did some rounds of IUIs, and after that, not working, strangely, wasn't sure why,
sentences.zh: 我们做了几个周期的宫腔内人工授精（IUI），在那之后，没有成功，奇怪的是，不知道为什么，

sentences.en: we did some rounds of IVF, thinking, well, now we're going to the next phase.
sentences.zh: 我们做了一些试管婴儿（IVF）周期，心想，好吧，现在我们要进入下一个阶段了。

sentences.en: Surely, you know, he's healthy, I'm healthy with an IVF, we'll quickly conceive.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道的，他很健康，我很健康，通过试管婴儿，我们很快就会怀孕。

sentences.en: And yet, still no baby, no one came.
sentences.zh: 然而，依然没有婴儿，谁也没有来。

sentences.en: The IVF process for us and our path was, with every failed, really non-pregnancy,
sentences.zh: 对我们而言，试管婴儿的过程以及我们的道路是，每一次失败的、真正没有怀孕的经历，

sentences.en: It felt like the death of our hopes and dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 它感觉像是我们的希望和梦想的破灭。

sentences.en: It felt like the death of that tiny little embryo that was the closest thing we had to a child.
sentences.zh: 它感觉就像那个微小胚胎的死亡，那是我们最接近孩子的存在。

sentences.en: And this wore equally on both of us.
sentences.zh: 这让我们两个人都身心俱疲。

sentences.en: You know, the baby showers of our friends and the little pink onesies
sentences.zh: 你知道的，朋友们的迎婴派对，还有那些小小的粉红色连体衣，

sentences.en: that we would find ourselves buying for other people.
sentences.zh: 我们会发现自己在为其他人购买这些东西。

sentences.en: It was increasingly very, very depressing.
sentences.zh: 这越来越让人感到非常非常沮丧。

sentences.en: I understand that in some ways this felt like a spiritual crisis to you.
sentences.zh: 我理解在某些方面这让你感觉像是一场精神危机。
你能解释一下为什么吗，丽莎？

sentences.en: Shankar, as we went further down this road of trials, of no child coming,
sentences.zh: 尚卡尔，随着我们在这条充满考验、没有孩子到来的道路上走得更远，

sentences.en: right as we really were in a season of tremendous pain,
sentences.zh: 就在我们真正处于巨大痛苦的时期时，

sentences.en: I started to notice helpers along the path
sentences.zh: 我开始注意到沿途出现的帮手，

sentences.en: and increasing synchronicities that were buoyant and guiding along the path.
sentences.zh: 以及沿途越来越多令人振奋且具有指引作用的共时性。

sentences.en: There started to be more and more light in this tunnel of pure occlusion.
sentences.zh: 在这个完全封闭黑暗的隧道里，开始有了越来越多的光亮。

sentences.en: For instance, I was on the bus once, coming in late to work.
sentences.zh: 例如，有一次我在公交车上，上班迟到了。

sentences.en: I'd had another failed in vitro.
sentences.zh: 我的又一次体外受精失败了。

sentences.en: I couldn't even pull it out of bed.
sentences.zh: 我甚至无法把自己从床上拉起来。

sentences.en: I ended up getting on the bus up to Columbia at 11 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我最后在早上11点坐上了去哥伦比亚大学的公交车。

sentences.en: I was sitting way in the back.
And suddenly, a somewhat unusual gentleman gets on.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个有点异乎寻常的绅士上了车。

sentences.en: And I think, no, you're kidding me.
He's walking all the way through the empty bus to the very back row
sentences.zh: 他穿过整辆空荡荡的公交车，一直走到最后面一排，

sentences.en: to sit one seat away from me, plopped down right next to me.
sentences.zh: 坐在离我只有一个座位的地方，直接在我旁边扑通坐下。

sentences.en: And here I was quite depressed.
And he said, you know what, lady?
You look like just that type of awfully nice lady
sentences.zh: 你看起来就像那种非常好心的女士，

sentences.en: that would go all around the world adopting kids.
sentences.zh: 会跑到世界各地去收养孩子。

sentences.en: And Shankar, he got off at the next stop.
sentences.zh: 而且尚卡尔，他在下一站就下车了。

sentences.en: Who rides a bus one stop?
Well, my husband and I were so determined to get pregnant
sentences.zh: 好吧，我和丈夫为了怀孕下定决心，

sentences.en: We went from one clinic to the next
sentences.zh: 我们从一家诊所换到另一家诊所，

sentences.en: because the next clinic had slightly higher rates of conception.
sentences.zh: 因为下一家诊所的受孕率略高一些。

sentences.en: And after that, we went to one of the teams
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们去找了其中一个团队，

sentences.en: that had discovered in vitro working with cellular animals.
sentences.zh: 他们曾在细胞动物身上发现过体外受精的作用。

sentences.en: And we kept going up and up and up, you will,
sentences.zh: 我们不断攀升，如果你愿意的话，

sentences.en: the ladder of more sophisticated, higher rates of conception.
sentences.zh: 攀登那座更复杂、受孕率更高的阶梯。

sentences.en: And yet there was always a sense in my heart
sentences.zh: 然而，我心中始终有一种感觉：

sentences.en: that for us in our journey, on our path, we were in the wrong office.
sentences.zh: 对于我们和我们的旅程而言，我们走错了办公室。

sentences.en: I'm wondering as you were experiencing this, Lisa,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，当你经历这一切时，丽莎，

sentences.en: as you were going from office to office,
sentences.zh: 当你从一个办公室走到另一个办公室时，

sentences.en: as you were experiencing, you know, failed attempt after failed attempt,
sentences.zh: 当你经历了一次又一次失败的尝试时，

sentences.en: But just talk a little bit about the effect this had on you and your husband.
sentences.zh: 但请谈谈这给你和你的丈夫带来的影响。

sentences.en: You must have asked yourself, why is this being denied to us?
sentences.zh: 你们一定问过自己，为什么这被剥夺了？

sentences.en: It's this thing that so many people have around the world.
sentences.zh: 这是全世界许多人都有的东西。

sentences.en: You know, there are billions of human beings.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有数十亿人类。

sentences.en: Why is this gift being denied to us?
sentences.zh: 为什么这份恩赐要被拒绝给我们？
尚卡尔，这真的很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: A plus B plus C, he was healthy, I was healthy.
sentences.zh: A加B加C，他很健康，我也很健康。

sentences.en: You know, of course, I searched my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当然，我审视了自己的生活。

sentences.en: Was there something physically or perhaps morally that I'd done wrong?
sentences.zh: 我是否在身体上或道德上做错了什么？

sentences.en: But there was no horrible, hard stop.
sentences.zh: 但并没有那种可怕的、绝对的硬性阻碍。

sentences.en: It started to become clear to us through the synchronicities that kept landing in our path
sentences.zh: 通过不断降临在我们道路上的共时性，我们逐渐清晰地意识到，

sentences.en: that maybe we were on a guided journey.
sentences.zh: 也许我们正在经历一段受到指引的旅程。

sentences.en: As tough and as painful and without light to see,
sentences.zh: 尽管艰难、痛苦且看不到光亮，

sentences.en: we started to feel that we were held.
sentences.zh: 我们开始感觉到我们被托举着。

sentences.en: For instance, after an in vitro,
sentences.zh: 例如，在一次体外受精之后，

sentences.en: which was by the team of all teams who had invented in vitro,
sentences.zh: 那是来自发明了体外受精的顶级专家团队的治疗，

sentences.en: we were at a very top hospital in solidarity,
sentences.zh: 我们在一家顶尖医院里休戚与共，

sentences.en: my husband by my side on bed reSt.
sentences.zh: 我的丈夫陪伴在我身旁，卧床休息。

sentences.en: And because it was only one night,
we'd splurged for a very nice hotel.
sentences.zh: 我们在一家非常好的酒店挥霍了一把。

sentences.en: My husband clicks the remote and only one channel,
sentences.zh: 我丈夫点击遥控器，在我们这家价格虚高的酒店电视上，只有一个频道，

sentences.en: only one channel will show on this TV in our overpriced hotel.
sentences.zh: 只有一个频道能放出来。

sentences.en: Well, he bangs the remote, he goes and fiddles with the TV.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他拍打着遥控器，去摆弄电视。
只有一个关于孤儿的纪录片，

sentences.en: a little boy who lives in a garbage dump in Central America.
sentences.zh: 一个住在中美洲垃圾场的 小男孩。

sentences.en: And through the translator, the little boy says,
I don't care that I live in the trash dump.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎我住在垃圾堆里。

sentences.en: I don't care that I don't go to school.
But it hurts so much to not be loved
sentences.zh: 但没有人在爱，这让我感到太痛了，

sentences.en: that I sniff glue to make the pain go away.
sentences.zh: 以至于我吸胶水来让痛苦消失。

sentences.en: And I looked at my husband and he looked at me
sentences.zh: 我看着我丈夫，他看着我，

sentences.en: there's a child out there for us.
sentences.zh: 外面有一个属于我们的孩子。
那是不可否认的共时性。

sentences.en: What life are you showing me now?
sentences.zh: 你现在向我展示的是什么生活？

sentences.en: we knew that we were on a guided journey.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们正在经历一段受到指引的旅程。

sentences.en: once we acknowledged being on this journey,
sentences.zh: 一旦我们意识到自己正踏上这段旅程，

sentences.en: just deepened and became more vivid
sentences.zh: 它就变得更加深邃、更加生动，

sentences.en: listen, I just want you to know my neighbor, Margaret,
sentences.zh: 听着，我只是想让你知道我的邻居玛格丽特，

sentences.en: she just adopted the most beautiful little boy from Russia.
sentences.zh: 她刚从俄罗斯收养了一个极其可爱的小男孩。

sentences.en: And well, I just wanted you to know, honey, bye.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我只是想告诉你一声，亲爱的，再见。

sentences.en: I mean, in some ways, Lisa,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从某些方面来说，丽莎，

sentences.en: the model that you had in your head

sentences.zh: 是认为为人父母就是通过怀孕生育。

sentences.en: And really, what these signals were telling you
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这些信号传达给你的意思是

sentences.en: is that, no, parenting is not about conception.
sentences.zh: 不，为人父母并不在于十月怀胎。

sentences.en: Forever commitment and forever love is parenting.
sentences.zh: 永远的承诺和永远的爱，这才是为人父母。
如果我们怀上一个孩子，

sentences.en: then perhaps they'll have my husband's humor
sentences.zh: 那么他们也许会遗传我丈夫的幽默感，

sentences.en: that I so valued from my side of the family.
sentences.zh: 我从我们家族这边极为珍视的品质。

sentences.en: And I sort of pieced together in my mind
sentences.zh: 我在脑海里拼凑出这样一种观念：

sentences.en: the notion that parenting really was conception.
sentences.zh: 认为为人父母确实就是靠怀孕。

sentences.en: But what our road of trials revealed
sentences.zh: 但我们这一路经历的磨难，

sentences.en: through the bright and supportive moments of synchronicity
sentences.zh: 通过那些明亮而支持性的共时性时刻展现出来的是，

sentences.en: was that parenting is love and commitment.
sentences.zh: 为人父母就是爱与承诺。

sentences.en: And even more, what the journey showed us
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，这段旅程向我们展示的是，

sentences.en: was that to be someone ready to inherit parenthood,
sentences.zh: 要成为一个准备好继承父母身份的人，

sentences.en: that I needed to let go of a certain level of ego and control.
sentences.zh: 我需要放下一定程度的自我和控制欲。

sentences.en: I'll share with you that one night I was deep in sleep
sentences.zh: 我跟你们分享一下，有一天晚上我睡得很沉，

sentences.en: when suddenly just, whoosh, I sat up wide and alert,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，呼地一下，我整个人一下子清醒地坐了起来，

sentences.en: sat up straight up in bed.
sentences.zh: 在床上挺直了身子坐着。

sentences.en: I felt coming a very profound, very sacred presence
sentences.zh: 我感觉到一个非常深邃、非常神圣的存在

sentences.en: Space opened up, but there was a numinous opening.
sentences.zh: 空间敞开了，那是一个充满神灵气息的入口。

sentences.en: And a very clear question was asked.
sentences.zh: 并且提出了一个非常明确的问题。

sentences.en: If you were pregnant now, would you adopt?
sentences.zh: 如果你现在怀孕了，你会收养吗？

sentences.en: In front of a presence so holy and so profound,
sentences.zh: 在如此神圣而深邃的存在面前，
它并非阴郁，而是极其庄严，
